title: 第2894章 九劫第2893章 收服紫霄劫雷
lines: 有了第一道与第二道仙品异种元素，剩下的对于江尘而言已经彻底不再是问题。
他先是回到太一宗，在时间日晷空间内修炼了一番后，外界只不过过去一会儿的功夫，就已然成功突破七劫虚仙。
随后便在老地方渡过雷劫，便接着前往下一个圣地，昆仑圣地。
昆仑圣地在各大圣地之中拥有十分独特的地位。
它是除了三大圣地之外，最为古老的一大圣地。
其圣地之中所拥有的仙品异金，也使得圣地弟子皆掌握了强大的战斗能力。
随着江尘一行人来到圣地后，与几位相熟的长老先是交谈一番，随后便以天眼找出了圣地内潜藏的叛徒。
做完这一切后，在圣地内部完全保持安全的情况下，这才出手收服了昆仑圣地的异金。
等到收服成功，江尘才知道此异金的名字。
其名为赤烁鎏元，乃是一种赤红色鎏金，拥有所有异种元素中，最为锋锐的力量。
并且可以赐予自己或他人这种力量，而在战斗过程中无往不利。
不过，或许是自己的修为已经达到了极高的层次，这一次收服过后，自身修为只是堪堪达到了七劫虚仙高阶，距离巅峰还有一段距离。
当下，江尘便直接前往下一个圣地，青冥圣地，收服了圣地内的仙品异木，青芽生息木。
在多种克制木系的异种元素帮助下，这道异种元素可谓是目前收服的最为轻松的一道了。
再加上青芽生息木本身就是蕴含着纯粹的生机之力的异种元素，收服过程中，也没有遇到太大的阻力。
直至这一道异种元素收服完成，江尘的修为直接越过七劫虚仙巅峰，成功抵达八劫层次。
为了不暴露，江尘在突破的第一时间就随着三位族长回到老地方，直至渡劫完成，才又回到时间日晷稳定修为。
这一过程，也持续到了后续相继收服仙品异水，沧澜仙水，以及仙品异土，赭岩镇岳土。
这一次江尘接连收服两道仙品异种元素，才让修为达到八阶巅峰，并且还只是堪堪抵达，距离突破还有很远。
见此情形，江尘瞬间意识到，收服仙品异种元素带来的提升已然有了边际效应。
再加上自己修为越来越逼近巅峰，提升难度也越来越大。
恐怕收服所有仙品异种元素后，也未必能真正抵达九劫巅峰。
不过，有了目前的修为，自己也已经相当满意了。
当下又立刻来到潮音圣地，将青霄裂空罡风收入囊中，修为正式迈入九劫虚仙，并成功渡劫。
至此八大仙品异种元素中，唯一没有收服的，就只剩下北冥圣地中，那道仙品异冰了。
感受到自身如今的实力，江尘眼眸之中浮现出浓浓的杀意。
“苍冥，终于到了回报你的时候了！”
“不知你可已经洗干净了脖子，做好了被我宰杀的准备？”
九劫虚仙，外加七大仙品异种元素，已然将自身实力推进到了前无古人的境地。
区区一个苍冥，早已不被自己放在眼中。
如今，是该将往日的恩怨回报了。
content_en:
With the first and second immortal elements, the rest is no longer a problem for Jiang Chen.
He first returned to Taiyi Sect, and after practicing in the time sundial space, he successfully broke through the Seven Tribulations Void Immortal in just a short time.
Then he survived the thunder tribulation at the old place, and then went to the next holy land, Kunlun Holy Land.
Kunlun Holy Land occupies a very unique position among the major holy places.
It is the oldest holy place besides the three holy places.
The immortal gold contained in the holy land also enables the disciples of the holy land to master powerful combat abilities.
After Jiang Chen and his party arrived at the Holy Land, they first had a conversation with several familiar elders, and then used their eyes to find out the traitors hidden in the Holy Land.
After doing all this, and with complete safety inside the holy land, he took action to conquer the strange gold in Kunlun Holy Land.
Only after the conquest was successful did Jiang Chen know the name of this strange gold.
Its name is Chishuo gilded yuan, which is a kind of crimson gilded gold that possesses the sharpest power among all alien elements.
And you can give yourself or others this power, and you will be invincible during the battle.
However, perhaps his cultivation level has reached an extremely high level. After conquering this time, his cultivation level has only reached the high level of Seven Tribulations Void Immortal, and is still some distance away from the peak.
At that moment, Jiang Chen went directly to the next holy land, the Qingming Holy Land, and conquered the immortal and exotic trees in the holy land, the Green Buds and Living Trees.
With the help of various alien elements that restrain the wood element, this alien element can be said to be the easiest one to conquer so far.
In addition, the Green Bud Tree itself is a heterogeneous element containing pure vitality, so it did not encounter much resistance during the conquering process.
Until the conquest of this alien element was completed, Jiang Chen's cultivation directly surpassed the peak of the Seven Tribulations Void Immortal and successfully reached the Eight Tribulations level.
In order not to be exposed, Jiang Chen followed the three clan leaders back to their old place as soon as he broke through. It was not until the tribulation was completed that he returned to the Time Dial to stabilize his cultivation.
This process also continued until the subsequent conquering of Immortal Grade Different Water, Canglan Immortal Water, Immortal Grade Different Earth, and Ocher Rock Zhenyue Earth.
This time, Jiang Chen conquered two immortal-grade alien elements one after another, allowing his cultivation to reach the peak of the eighth level, and it was only barely there, and he was still far away from breaking through.
Seeing this situation, Jiang Chen instantly realized that the improvement brought about by conquering the alien elements of the Immortal Grade had already had marginal effects.
In addition, his cultivation level is getting closer and closer to the peak, and it is becoming more and more difficult to improve.
I am afraid that even after conquering all the immortal alien elements, we may not be able to truly reach the peak of the Nine Tribulations.
However, with the current level of cultivation, I am already quite satisfied.
At that moment, he immediately came to Chaoyin Holy Land, took the Qingxiao Split Konggang Wind into his bag, and officially entered the Nine Tribulations Void Immortal realm, and successfully overcame the tribulation.
So far, among the eight immortal alien elements, the only one that has not been conquered is the immortal alien ice in Beiming Holy Land.
Feeling his current strength, Jiang Chen's eyes showed strong murderous intent.
"Cang Ming, it's finally time to repay you!"
"I wonder if you have washed your neck and are ready to be slaughtered by me?"
The Nine Tribulations Void Immortal, coupled with the alien elements of the Seven Great Immortals, has pushed its own strength to an unprecedented level.
A mere Cang Ming has long been ignored by him.
Now, it's time to pay back the grudges of the past.
